scope: Broaden primary-source comparison of explicit DXF 3D geometry, ACIS/ASM carrier access, lossy mesh projection, B-rep semantics, and FreeCAD stock-consumer acceptance; refine existing plan gates only.

method.kind: Primary Autodesk format documentation, current FreeCAD source and maintainer issue, GDAL and ezdxf project documentation, plus local plan cross-check
method.evidenceBoundary: Autodesk defines the DXF carrier framing only. FreeCAD main is mutable source; the no-token observation is limited to the inspected translation unit, while the maintainer statement is scoped to stock FreeCAD ACIS import. GDAL/ezdxf findings are documented capability limits, not local runtime observations. No drawing or shape was tested.

evidence.observed: The documented record has a modeler-version marker, proprietary group-1 payload with optional group-3 continuation chunks, and a separate soft-owner history handle.
doesNotEstablish: the ACIS/SAB grammar or B-rep validity
that raw carrier preservation is equivalent to shape interpretation
that rewriting the body as a mesh is lossless
evidence.planUse: Keep carrier bytes/chunk order and history reference separate from body completeness, shape validity, projection, and consumer acceptance.

evidence.topic: FreeCAD stock explicit-geometry and ACIS-import boundary
evidence.observed: The inspected current importer translation unit has a generic Open CASCADE shape-publication path with a 3DFACE example comment, but no direct 3DSOLID/SOLID3D token route. A FreeCAD maintainer states stock FreeCAD cannot read proprietary ACIS blobs and closed issue #18454 as not planned.
doesNotEstablish: complete FreeCAD support for every explicit DXF 3D entity
the state of every importer backend or third-party plugin
runtime acceptance by a particular FreeCAD release/platform
evidence.planUse: Keep direct FreeCAD acceptance scoped to named entity/backend profiles and expected settings. Treat stock ACIS import as NOT_APPLICABLE unless a separately named plugin/kernel route is selected.

evidence.observed: The DXF driver skips modeler entities by default because it cannot transform them into OGR geometry. Its optional AC1027+ mode exposes raw ASMData and a 12-real ASMTransform without constructing a solid.
evidence.planUse: Admit GDAL only as an optional raw-carrier/transform comparator with exact source identity and owner/placement checks; do not count it as a geometry or ACIS semantic oracle.

evidence.topic: ezdxf limited ACIS parsing and flat-face mesh projection
evidence.observed: The project documents a limited ACIS subset; unsupported records can become NONE_ENTITY and be lost. Its body-to-mesh conversion is limited to flat polygonal faces and is not a general curved-surface B-rep kernel.
doesNotEstablish: arbitrary SAT/SAB semantic completeness or lossless round trip
a fresh runtime result on any payload in this repository
evidence.planUse: Use ezdxf only for exact supported-profile carrier/syntax controls and flat-face vectors, capturing unsupported records and dispositions. Never count a flat mesh as ACIS/B-rep parity.

evidence.topic: ACIS header unit scalar versus coordinate transform
evidence.observed: Autodesk's SAT-only support article says export units follow INSUNITS and documents mm, inch, and unitless header values. Ansys says its ACIS SAT/SAB reader obtains units from the geometry file without identifying the exact binary field. cadmpeg calls the BinaryFile4 header scalar scale metadata and says it is not a coordinate transform; that is peer documentation, not a normative modern-SAB contract.
doesNotEstablish: that all current SAB/ASM profiles use identical unit semantics
the required normalization order relative to modeler, entity, or INSERT transforms
that raw wireframe coordinates should be scaled by the header scalar
evidence.planUse: Preserve and expose the exact parsed header scalar as source metadata without scaling coordinates. Resolve physical-unit interpretation only per a pinned producer/version profile with independent consumer evidence.

futureProjectionRequirements: source-native analytic expectations and carrier disposition
declared linear/angular deflection and unit/transform order
topology, winding, degeneracy, and bounded-facet checks
owner, block, and INSERT placement validation
visible per-source loss/projection status before output publication
implementationReadiness.validationCadence: Implementation slices keep generated local vectors, the touched strict target, one focused test, applicable LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3 compile gate, and diff check. GDAL/ezdxf peer comparisons and FreeCAD native runs remain composed-only.

validation.relatedImplementationSlice: Additive drw_decodeAcisWireframeWithHeader API was implemented and validated separately; it returns raw header metadata without scaling output coordinates and preserves existing public result layout and decoder symbols.
